name: Go-kart
summary: Low open go-kart in side view with fat tyres, bucket seat, rear engine and steering wheel; for racing scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: floor line: the tyres stand on y

params.name: s
params.note: about 800 px wide and 330 px tall at s = 1; about 0.6 next to a person

params.name: anim
params.note: drive = wheels spin and the body bounces (also on when vx is not 0)

params.name: vx
params.note: horizontal speed in px per frame (negative = left; set flip too)

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror so the kart faces left
